title: Live fixes: Claude's refusal of the expert prompt, the thinking's text, the lane's status, and the remembered draft
request: The owner found that nothing worked: no answer, Claude never called. The owner gave ten dollars to test live and record everything, and asked to keep the expert prompt and use the model's reasoning.
spec: The expert prompt reworded as a solution design (the persona and the failures kept), summarized thinking asked for, a refusal said on the lane, the lane's status kept on the session, Home's remembered draft kept across a failed read.
plan: Reproduce on the owner's real key, bisect what fails, fix it, and prove it on the owner's own example.

decisions.decision: The two passages Claude refused are not reworded to slip past the refusal; the deliverable is asked for, and the reasoning comes from the API's summarized thinking.
decisions.why: The refusal is the model's own safeguard; the product needs the design, and the supported way to see the reasoning is extended thinking.

change: dclab_rnd/prompts/ai_first_expert.md, ai_first_follow.md, ai_first_home.md, dclab_rnd/models/anthropic_client.py, dclab_rnd/twin/home.py, design.py, the Home page.

findings.defect: Nothing seemed to work on the page the owner tried.
findings.scenario: The owner used the scripted test server left open in the browser pane, with live models off by design.
findings.cause: A test server without a model was left where the owner would see it, and the lane hid why Claude did not answer.
findings.fix: The test server is stopped after checks, and the lane says why Claude cannot answer.

findings.defect: Claude refused the expert prompt with no output.
findings.scenario: Live: the stop reason was a refusal with zero output tokens, with and without thinking, on a churn problem too.
findings.cause: Two passages asked the model to write down how it thinks so it could be kept and compared.
findings.fix: The prompt asks for a solution design; the persona and the failure lessons are kept word for word; a refusal is said on the lane, never hidden as unreadable.
findings.test: checked live on the owner's example

findings.scenario: The thinking blocks arrived with no text.
findings.cause: Newer models omit the thinking's text unless a summary is asked for.
findings.fix: Every thinking request asks for a summarized display, kept in thinking.jsonl and shown under its reading.

findings.defect: A failed read on load forgot the remembered draft.
findings.scenario: Reloading Home while the server was busy left the page empty.
findings.cause: Any error was treated as a deleted draft.
findings.fix: Only a draft that is gone is forgotten.

measurements.name: live Home with Claude beside, the owner's fraud example
measurements.gate: none: a check that both sides answer
measurements.result: DCLab's Home agent with Claude read the return fraud into the understanding and asked when to catch a return; Claude's lane proposed anomaly scoring, investigator review of the top and a random sample as the first labels, two turns.
limits: One conversation; not a measurement of quality.

outcome: Claude answers on Home beside DCLab live, with its reasoning summarized.
lessons: Run the real path with the real key before calling a feature done.
Never leave a test server where the owner will try the product.
risks: Training models on Claude's outputs needs the owner's check of Anthropic's terms.
